An Inter-Club meeting at Chiswick on the last day of May saw the Bel's turn out in force in the 800m to show what depth we have in this event. A battle royal went on between John Martin and Dave McMillan for third and fourth place; & shotputter John just won.
Philip Gee bore our standard bravely, however, clocking good times for second places in the 400m. and 800m. 100m 4th D.McMillan 200m 5.D.McMillan 25.6s 400m 2.P.Gee 51.7s
A new name was added to those who have held the 'Denmark Pot' when on December 2nd, the Belgrave Dart Championship went to Don Maclean, who gained a narrow victory over Dave McMillan.
And now Dave McMillan, the hairy young villain, Had a bad patch and knew nowt what to do.
You may be lucky (?) enough to hear 'news-hound' TOM POLLOCK giving a round up of athletic results during the sportsnews, or even DAVE McMILLAN on the traffic reports.
Runners up were Bob Barnes, 220, and Denis MacManus, 211, with Dave McMillan, Gordon Doubleday, John 'The Treasurer' Baker and Carl Lawton not far behind.

The 'Denmark Pot' for the Club Darts Championship was won by DAVE McMILLAN from COLIN PEARSON after a nerve racking final and some remarkable early rounds when all the favourites went out to the most unlikely players.
Half way down the pack Dave McMillan heads Eddie Thorp, Roy Coombs, Doug Maughan and Dennis Jones.
In December the "Denmark Pot" once again returned to the safe keeping of Bill Couzens as he relieved Dave McMillan of the Club Darts Championship, the beaten finalist being Bernard Merry.
